description: A common inflammatory disorder of pilosebaceous units producing comedones and inflammatory lesions, usually on the face, chest, and back.
causes: Inflammation and changes involving Cutibacterium acnes

appearance.general: A mixed eruption of open and closed comedones with inflammatory papules, pustules, or deeper nodules.
appearance.dark_skin: Acne may be followed by persistent post-inflammatory hyperpigmentation in skin of colour.

warning_signs: Severe nodular acne or scarring should prompt professional assessment.
general_first_aid: Use gentle skin cleansing and avoid harsh scrubbing.
prevention: Reduce avoidable occlusive or irritating products when they clearly worsen lesions.
doctor_discussion_points: Discuss severity, scarring, menstrual or hormonal associations, and medication history.
